# AirPodsMode v0.3.2-preview

## Fixes (S26 Ultra / One UI 9 / Android 17)

1. **POST_NOTIFICATIONS** — clear Chinese/English rationale on first launch; Activity Result API; app never crashes if denied.
2. **BLUETOOTH_CONNECT** — requested before scan/connect; bonded AirPods list refreshes on ACL connect/disconnect.
3. **Location** — still requested separately when enabling Last Connected Location; FGS only adds `location` type when granted.
4. **Denied notifications** — in-app banner + open App Settings; **foreground-only connect** while the app is open so you can still switch modes.
5. **QS tiles** — if notifications missing, open the control panel and prompt for permission instead of silently failing.
6. **Detection** — name/alias heuristics + single connected audio-headset fallback when OEM hides the AirPods name.

Install, grant **Nearby devices / Bluetooth**, then **Notifications** for background + last-location. Without notifications you can still Connect with the app open.
